title: Completeness of the character tester
statement: Let $L$ be a finite system of homogeneous quadratic equations over $\mathbb F_2$, and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^{n^2}$ satisfy every equation of $L$. Then the linearized-system character tester for $L$ accepts the function $x\mapsto a\cdot x$ with probability exactly $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a homogeneous quadratic system in dimension $n$
$a$ is a binary vector of length $n^2$
